The mouth area appears smeared or fused, lacking clear lip definition. It looks like a painting or a distorted doll face rather than a coherent anatomical feature.
The hands holding the clear object at the bottom are poorly defined, with fingers merging into the object and each other. The geometry of the held item is ambiguous.
